baseline: Base 77f03c7cecf8f118f038a68cb8df7037d4b44e1f contains the DEVX-043 task spec. Attempt 1 (resultSha 6522cd91f) shipped the candidate-list/parse/replay/verdict IPC layer, preload bridge and renderer overlay, but the overlay rendered null unless the window event coop-learning-review:open fired, and nothing dispatched it (BLOCKER); criterion 5 hands-on evidence absent (MAJOR); parseReportCandidates always set citation:null so DEVX-025 report-origin candidates could never replay (MAJOR); two wiring files touched outside scope.allow (MAJOR). Attempt 2 (resultSha 1f783be8d) applied the reviewer's correction scope: titlebar trigger button dispatches COOP_LEARNING_REVIEW_OPEN_EVENT; parseReportCandidates emits citation { file: repo-relative report path, section: 'Candidato <marker> · <title>' }; verdictsFilePathFor/saveVerdicts/setVerdict reject traversal sources; scope.allow lists both wiring files. Attempt 3 (this artifact) fixes the attempt-2 BLOCKER: loadCandidates' report branch called path.relative() but the file only imported named node:path members, so coopLearningReview:load threw ReferenceError: path is not defined at runtime and the screen showed zero candidates. Fix reuses the already-imported named relative() (matches the file's import style) and adds a test that invokes the real registered load handler with a report present at its default path. Criterion-5 evidence was re-captured through the real registered IPC handlers, not the pure parsers.
